description: Implementation of UCI scheduler logic for resource allocation, UE management, and scheduling in a cellular network context.

classes.name: uci_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the UCI scheduling logic, resource management, and UE configuration handling.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Performs scheduling for a specific slot, allocating UCIs for UEs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears internal data structures to stop scheduling.

methods.name: add_resource
methods.description: Adds a resource (SR or CSI) for a UE at specified offset and period.

methods.name: rem_resource
methods.description: Removes a resource (SR or CSI) for a UE at specified offset and period.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE configuration to the scheduler.

methods.name: add_ue_to_grid
methods.description: Internal method to add UE resources to the scheduling grid.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE's resources based on new and old configurations.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE's resources from the scheduling grid.

methods.name: get_ue_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the UE configuration for a given RNTI.

methods.name: schedule_slot_ucis
methods.description: Schedules UCIs for a specific slot.

methods.name: schedule_updated_ues_ucis
methods.description: Schedules UCIs for UEs with recent configuration updates.
